evals.name: list-mssql-hosts
evals.prompt: Show me the SQL Server hosts in this account and region.
evals.expected_output: Lists managed MSSQL hosts via database-hosts GET with id, name, ssmStatus.
expectations: Uses GET .../mssql/credentials/.../regions/.../database-hosts for inventory
Summarizes host id, name, and ssmStatus
Does not fabricate databaseHostId values

evals.name: ontap-snapshot-routing
evals.prompt: Create an ONTAP snapshot for MSSQL data volume wlmdb_sqldata on FSx fs-0123456789abcdef0 in us-east-1.
evals.expected_output: Routes to ONTAP proxy snapshot path with confirmation gate.
expectations: Uses WF proxy path with fsxId and x-endpoint header
POST api/storage/volumes/{uuid}/snapshots or resolves volume UUID first
Asks for explicit confirmation before mutating POST
Polls ONTAP job after snapshot create

evals.name: create-database-routing
evals.prompt: Create a new MSSQL database AdventureWorks on host host-prod-sql-01.
evals.expected_output: WLMDB create database API with drive and collation pre-reads when SSM connected.
expectations: Resolves databaseHostId via GET .../database-hosts before POST
Checks ssmStatus or reads drive-information/collation pre-reads
Uses POST .../database-hosts/{hostId}/database for create
Asks for explicit confirmation before POST
Polls GET .../jobs/{jobId} after 202 response

evals.name: clone-with-ssm-routing
evals.prompt: Clone ProductionDB to a dev sandbox named ProductionDB_Dev on the same host.
evals.expected_output: WLMDB sandbox POST with full body.
expectations: Uses POST .../sandboxes with source, destination, mountPoints, and tag
Pre-reads sandboxes or mount-points before POST
Asks for explicit confirmation before POST
Polls job after 202 response

evals.name: sandbox-delete-confirmation
evals.prompt: Delete sandbox ProductionDB_Dev on host host-prod-sql-01 instance MSSQLSERVER.
evals.expected_output: DELETE sandbox with confirmation gate and job poll.
expectations: Treats delete as destructive and asks for confirmation
Uses DELETE .../sandboxes/{sandboxName}
Polls GET .../jobs/{jobId} after 202 response

evals.name: sandbox-refresh-routing
evals.prompt: Refresh sandbox ProductionDB_Dev from source on host host-prod-sql-01.
expectations: Uses PATCH .../sandboxes/{sandboxName} with action REFRESH
Asks for explicit confirmation before PATCH
Polls job after 202 response

evals.name: sandbox-rebaseline-snapshots
evals.prompt: Re-baseline sandbox ProductionDB_Dev to snapshot netapp_wf_clone_1717000000.
evals.expected_output: GET snapshots pre-read then PATCH RE-BASELINE, then poll job.
expectations: Reads GET .../sandboxes/{sandboxName}/snapshots before or alongside PATCH
Uses PATCH with action RE-BASELINE and snapshot name
Asks for explicit confirmation before PATCH
Polls job after 202 response

evals.name: sandbox-split-confirmation
evals.prompt: Split sandbox ProductionDB_Dev on host host-prod-sql-01.
evals.expected_output: GET split-estimate, confirm irreversibility, POST split.
expectations: Reads GET .../split-estimate before split
States split is irreversible in confirmation prompt
Uses POST .../sandboxes/{sandboxName}/split
Polls job after response

evals.name: clone-without-ssm-routing
evals.prompt: Clone this database without SSM — give me the ONTAP steps for ProductionDB on FSx fs-0123456789abcdef0.
evals.expected_output: Numbered ONTAP CLI (show only, not executed); no WLMDB sandboxes POST; no /proxy/v1 REST.
expectations: Does not POST .../sandboxes WLMDB API
Does not use Workload Factory /proxy/v1 REST curls for storage steps
Provides numbered ONTAP CLI including volume snapshot create and volume clone create (FlexClone); does not execute them
Lists remaining manual host/SQL steps after ONTAP steps, including Standalone vs FCI
Does not claim SQL sandbox is fully ready after storage-only steps

evals.name: refuse-wad
evals.prompt: Show drift assessment clone dimension findings for my MSSQL instance.
evals.expected_output: Refuses WAD scope and redirects to databases-wad.
expectations: States registered drift assessment is out of scope for this skill
Redirects to databases-wad skill
Does not call assessment endpoints as substitute

evals.name: ssm-not-connected-manual-ontap
evals.prompt: Create database AdventureWorks on host host-prod-sql-01. The host ssmStatus is NotConnected.
evals.expected_output: No WLMDB POST; numbered ONTAP CLI volume/LUN/map instructions shown, not executed.
expectations: Does not POST .../database-hosts/{hostId}/database
Does not use Workload Factory /proxy/v1 REST curls for storage provisioning
Provides numbered ONTAP CLI for volume create, lun create, and lun mapping; does not execute them
Lists manual Windows/SQL steps for CREATE DATABASE on the host
Notes SSM is NotConnected and WLMDB create-db is not available
